phase: ## Phase S8: Default look for new editions
summary: PASS at bbe3d68f with 0 Blockers and 3 Nits. F1, F2, F3, and F4 of round 1 are fixed, and real-code probes confirm each fix. The new POST 409 path, the PUT look check, the look-keeping write, and the existence check hold on every path that the dashboard UI can reach. A PUT cannot drop the look by omission. A PUT can change the look on purpose, and that is by design. The 3 Nits are API-level or theoretical: a cross-type id shadows a shipped project (F5), a PUT with look null replaces the marker (F6), and the guards are not atomic (F7).
nonblocking_findings: F5 [Nit] review-b: the existence check in createProject covers one series folder, but a project id resolves in both folders and secondary/ comes first (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:295, :325, :44, and :77-98). A POST with type secondary and the id of a shipped Primary project creates secondary/origins-2-a0. Then readProjectMetadata, listLessons, compile, and PUT resolve to the empty twin. The probe showed 0 lessons where primary/origins-2-a0 holds 1 file, and listProjects returned two entries with one id. The dashboard options cannot make this id, because 0 ids are offered by both types. A raw API call or the legacy name can. Rationale: no look flips and no shipped file changes, but dashboard/scripts/print/make-lesson-pdfs.ts:71-74 and dashboard/scripts/print/export-print-data.ts:46-60 print zero lessons with no error. Fix: refuse an id that exists in either series folder. Add a POST route test for the 409 and for the cross-type id.

F6 [Nit] review-b: a PUT with look null replaces the stored look with null. The route check accepts null through parseLook (dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts:53), and the merge keeps a stored look only when the new look is undefined (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:230). The probe turned the look of the shipped project quest-4-a1 from classic to null, and the look of a new Primary project from chibi-quest to classic. Rationale: null renders as classic, so a shipped book does not flip, but the explicit marker is gone and the route comment says a write with no look keeps the look. Fix: answer 400 for null, or treat null as absent. Add a failing-first test.

F7 [Nit] review-b: the new guards are not atomic, and one test comment overstates them. createProject checks the folder (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:295 and :325) and then calls mkdir with recursive, which does not fail on an existing folder (:297 and :327). Eight concurrent creates of one new id all resolved in 20 of 20 probe rounds. writeProjectMetadata reads the look (:231) and writes later (:234), and readProjectLook returns no look on any read error (:247-250). A damaged project.json lost its look in the probe, and 6400 concurrent look-less writes lost it 0 times. Rationale: a shipped id has a folder, so its 409 holds, and a new id gets equal bytes, so the risk is theoretical. dashboard/__tests__/default-look-guards.test.ts:14-15 says a create never overwrites and a write never drops the look. Fix: create the project folder with a non-recursive mkdir. Treat a read error other than ENOENT as an error. Write through a temp file and a rename. Reword the comment.

These are dashboard/lib/look.ts, dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts, dashboard/app/api/projects/route.ts, dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/metadata/route.ts, dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/compile/route.ts, and 3 test files. primary/, secondary/, and content/ are unchanged, so no shipped project.json changed in this round.

F1 verified fixed: a probe of dashboard/lib/look.ts on the 6 real project.json files returns classic for the 5 shipped Primary projects and for secondary/origins-3.1-a1 (look.ts:59-60). A secondary project, a project with no type, and a type that is not exactly primary give classic. A Primary project with no look gives chibi-quest. The test dashboard/__tests__/default-look-guards.test.ts:21-26 reads the real secondary file.
F4 verified fixed: projectLook gives classic for 'abc', 5, true, [], ['classic'], {}, null, and undefined (dashboard/lib/look.ts:45-47 and :59). A look of null gives classic.

F3 verified fixed: dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:13 and dashboard/app/api/projects/[projectId]/compile/route.ts:175-176 state the new rule. A grep finds no other text that names the book's look as the fallback of a project, except dashboard/lib/print/book-lessons.ts:24, which still describes the project-or-book choice.

F2 verified fixed for every path that the dashboard UI reaches. The Settings-save payload of 4 keys, sent through the real PUT route, kept look classic on the shipped projects quest-4-a1 and origins-2-a0, left a new Primary project without a look, and added no look to the secondary project (probe C). A create over the id of a shipped Primary project gave 409 and left its file unchanged (probe G). The legacy name 'Origins 3.1 A1' over the secondary project gave 409. The crafted id 'a-1/../origins-2-a0' and the upper-case variants gave 409, so id normalization does not bypass the check.

POST 409 path: dashboard/app/api/projects/route.ts:69-71 maps ProjectExistsError to 409, and the body holds the text Project '<id>' already exists. The echo holds only the id and no server path. The create dialog shows the text as a React child (dashboard/components/create-project-dialog.tsx:153), so an id with markup prints as text. A successful create still returns the absolute folder path in its body (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:338-344). That line stands at the phase base and is outside this audit.

PUT look check: the route answers 400 before any write for 'riven-lands', '', 'Classic', 0, false, true, [], ['classic'], {}, 'constructor', and a 5,000-character string, and the stored look stays classic. A body with look {toString:1} gives 400 with the text Cannot convert object to primitive value. The 400 body repeats the client's project id and look text (5,082 bytes for a 5,000-character look). It is JSON, it holds no server path, and the Settings dialog does not display it (dashboard/components/project-settings-dialog.tsx:92).
Prototype keys: a PUT body with a __proto__ key gives 200, keeps look classic, and leaves ({}).look undefined.

Path safety: assertSafePath runs before the new existence check (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:293 then :295, and :323 then :325), and both use the same path.join result. The traversal id '../x-1-a' and the legacy name '../escape' give a generic 500 and create no folder outside the series folder. A PUT with the id '..' gives a generic 500. The id '../secondary/origins-3.1-a1' aliases the secondary project inside the roots.

PUT can change a shipped look on purpose: look chibi-quest on the shipped origins-2-a0 gave 200 and changed the stored look (probe F). An explicit look wins by design (test-strategy.md, S8 test case 4), and the route cannot tell a shipped project. WORKBOOKS_READ_ONLY is unset here. With it set, create and save give a generic 500 before the existence check (dashboard/lib/filesystem.ts:223 and :285).

Legacy signature: createProject('My Legacy Project') gives type secondary, no look key, and projectLook classic. A second call with other spacing gives ProjectExistsError for the id my-legacy-project. The only caller is dashboard/app/api/projects/route.ts:66, which maps the error to 409. A legacy name equal to a shipped Primary id passes the check (F5).

Option lists: a computation over PRIMARY_LEVELS and SECONDARY_LEVELS (dashboard/lib/constants.ts) shows 0 ids offered by both types and 0 secondary options equal to a shipped Primary id. 4 Primary options equal a shipped id (origins-2-a0, origins-3.1-a0, origins-3.2-a0, quest-4-a1), and a create of each now gives 409.

Consumers: round 1 holds. The importer in tutor-advantage (import-primary-workbooks.ts:71-74) and the monorepo dry-run (dry-run-import.ts:57-79) ignore the look key, and this round changes no project.json.
Secrets and Thai: a scan of the round-2 code diffs finds no password, token, key, database URL, or home path. The round-2 dashboard diff holds 0 Thai characters. I read no lesson file.

A2: no round-2 file flips a draft to a published status, and S8 has no publish gate. A2 is not applicable. A6: measure/tracks.md has no change since my last round, and line 18 makes no resolved security claim.

Not covered by a test: the POST route (dashboard/app/api/projects/route.ts:69-71), the PUT look null, and the cross-type create. The probes in this review cover them.

The Settings dialog writes the cefrLevel of its option list, so a Save on the shipped quest-4-a1 would write A1 where the file holds A1- (read of dashboard/components/project-settings-dialog.tsx:75-80 and dashboard/lib/constants.ts:50).
